svg.text: RUNS FULL WIDTH, ALSO ACROSS KNEEHOLE
FRONT + SIDE · 1:2.5 · 50 WIDE AT KNEEHOLE, 34 ON CORNERS
RIGHT PEDESTAL FRONT · SCALE 1:10 · THREE EACH SIDE
PLAN · SCALE 1:4 · ALL FOUR CORNERS · EVERY LAYER TURNS 90°
Profiles are drawn from film stills and are indicative;
the joiner to prepare a full-size mock-up of 1, 2 and 7.
Carving (4, 5): carver to work from the reference photos;
sample one drop before carving the set.
Hardware (6): standard 90 mm swan-neck, solid brass.
Gold/brass on handles and ring pulls only; rest plain teak.
Corners: square, every layer mitred; moulding on each
face just in from the corner (8, 8B).
